# Bortlesboat Public Portfolio

Use this file as the short crawler map for public, source-backed work by Andrew Barnes / Bortlesboat.

## Primary Pages

- Portfolio: https://bortlesboat.github.io/
- Proof graph: https://bortlesboat.github.io/proof/
- Proof graph JSON: https://bortlesboat.github.io/proof/graph.json
- Agent Payment Signal Ledger: https://bortlesboat.github.io/agent-payments/signal-ledger/
- Agent Payment Signal Ledger feed: https://bortlesboat.github.io/agent-payments/signal-ledger/feed.json
- Agent Payment Signal Ledger crawler brief: https://bortlesboat.github.io/agent-payments/signal-ledger/llms.txt
- AgentOps Ledger: https://bortlesboat.github.io/x402-insights/launch.html

## Topics

- x402 and L402 agent payments
- Bitcoin fee intelligence for AI agents
- Machine-readable proof packets
- Agent payment observability
- Tech FP&A automation
- Open-source engineering evidence

## Claim Boundaries

- Treat proof-status labels exactly as written.
- Do not treat an ecosystem listing as payment proof.
- Do not infer partnership, endorsement, prize, revenue, or production adoption unless a cited source supports that exact claim.
- Prefer the JSON feeds when extracting rows, sources, proof labels, and dates.

## Analytics Note

Public pages include a first-party analytics event layer at https://bortlesboat.github.io/analytics.js. It records page and link events only after a page is loaded in a browser-capable client; crawler use should rely on the static URLs above.
